main_text.head: CAP. V. De vindicta diuina in Maximum, Grati-ani interfectorem, & obedientiam Or-thodoxorum praesertim vero Ambrosij in Valentinianum Iuniorem, Arrianum, & Theodosium seniorem.
main_text.p: DUo Valentiniani, senioris Filij, ijdem-que Augusti, factione Gentilium necati sunt. Gratianus quidem à Maximo, conspirantibus cum eo Gentilibus Senatoribus: Valentinianus vero Junior, proditione Argobastis laqueo strangu-latus est. Gratiani necem ita perpetra-tam memorat Paulus Diaconus. Maximus ab infensis Gratiano Militibus & Legionibus exceptus, eundem subita incursione perterritum, atque in Italiam transire cupientem, dolis circumuentū, per manus Andragathij Classis Praefecti interemit; sed verte folium, & sequenti pagina videbis hunc ipsum Maximum à suis Militibus apprehensum, vinctum, & Theodosio traditum ; Quem, cum Theodosium viderent oculis ad parcen-dum

page.notes: The left-hand column is blank. The right edge shows part of the facing page (LIB. III, p. 157), which is not transcribed. The running head "Scutum Regium" is read as "Scutum"; the printed form is slightly uncertain. The first letter of "Argobastis" is unclear in the scan; the reading is taken from the word's form. The bracketed passage is set inside the column with a bracket mark and is treated as a side note; its exact placement is uncertain. The last word of the page is "dum" printed on its own line, read as the end of "parcen-dum".
